title: Light-Painting a 1941 Chevy AK Pickup
description: Here's the one-of-a-kind light-painting of a cool 1941 Chevy AK Pickup. We chose the burned-out ruins of the historic Twohy Mercantile Building in Superior, Wisconsin, as the backdrop for this one. So cool!

title: "Ford vs Ferrari"
description: Here's our take on a poster for "Ford vs Ferrari" - a 2024 Ford Bronco Heritage Edition and a 2025 Ferrari Roma Spider.

title: Light Painting a 1958 Porsche 356A 1600 Speedster
description: This black 1958 Porsche 356A 1600 Speedster looks even better than the day it left the factory nearly 70 years ago! It was truly an honor that we had the opportunity to light paint it!

title: Light Painting 2 Harley-Davidson Motorcycles in Texas
description: Cool light painted photograph of a 2025 Harley-Davidson Custom Street Bob and a 2024 Harley-Davidson Nightster Special. This was the 4th light painting project in 2 nights at RGV Wing Commemorative Airport in Los Fresnos, Texas.

title: Light Painting 3 Ford Shelbys
description: A pretty light painted photograph of a 2022 Ford Shelby GT500 Mustang, a 2022 Ford Shelby F-150 Truck Offroad Series, and a 2024 Ford Shelby Super Snake Mustang. Once again, the RGV Wing Commemorative Airport in Los Fresnos, Texas was the location for this cool light painting project.

title: Light Painting 3 Harley's in Texas
description: A cool light painted photograph of three Harleys. From left to right we've got a 2023 Harley-Davidson “Fat Boy", a 2025 Harley-Davidson Tri-Glide Ultra, and a 2023 Harley-Davidson Breakout. This image was the second that Michael created that evening. The first, of a Cessna 182, was created about 100 yards from this one at RGV Wing Commemorative Airport near Brownsville, Texas. The before and after images of that cool light painting are in our Aircraft Light Painting Gallery.

title: Light Painting Four Vehicles and a Finnish Barn
description: A cool light painted photograph of a 2009 Corvette, a 1972 Chevelle, a 1963 Chevy Stepside C20, and a 2021 Dodge Ram truck. This beautiful image was created during the Canadian wildfires in the summer of 2025. Those fires made for quite the orange moon rise that evening!

title: Light Painting a Silver 1967 Ford Fairlane Ranchero
description: A beautiful light painting of a cool silver1967 Ford Fairlane Ranchero under a full moon. The smoke from the Canadian wildness made for an interesting sky that night. This pretty image was created on-location at a lake in northern Minnesota.

title: Light Painting a 1969 Doge Daytona Tribute Car
description: A light painted photograph of a cool 1970 Dodge Charger 500 that's been made into a 1969 Dodge Charger Daytona tribute car!

title: Light Painting a Rare 1957 Ford Fairlane 500 Skyliner
description: A pretty one-of-a-kind light painting of a rare1957 Ford Fairlane 500 Skyliner. We light painted this beauty from both the front and the back that night. It was created on the southern shore of Lake Superior in Washburn, Wisconsin.

title: Light Painting a Rare 1957 Ford Fairlane 500 Skyliner
description: We don't have a "before" image of this version. Because we created this after the previous one, it was too dark to have a starting shot.

title: Light Painting Three One-of-a-Kind Vehicles
description: A beautiful light painted photograph of three incredible ResotMod Creations under a full moon. A 1955 Chevrolet Bel Air "El Camino like" pickup truck with a Cadillac front-end (Ruby Slipper is the color), a 1939 LaSalle Rat Rod, and a 1978 Chevy Custom 3/4 ton pickup (Raspberry is the color).

title: Light Painting Nine Muscle Cars
description: A beautiful light painted photograph of nine muscle cars in northern Minnesota! In the garage, on the left lift, we've got a 2018 Camaro 2SS, and a 2009 Challenger RT on the right lift. On the Ground, from left to right, we've got a 1976 Camaro, a 1967 SS RS Camaro, a 1969 Chevelle Super Sport, a 1969 Mustang GT RestoMod, a 1968 GT 390 Mustang, a 1970 Plymouth Cuda, and last but not least, there's a 1998 Trans Am!

title: Light Painting a 1915 Model T and a 2008 Ford Shelby Mustang

title: An Amazing 8-Vehicle Light Painting
description: An amazing light painted photograph of the client’s beautiful home and 8 vehicles, all with unique names that are on their license plates! The 3 Motorcycles are: "KEEPIN", a 1995 Custom Harley-Davidson Road King, "FLOWIN", a Custom 2005 Speedway Chopper, and "FLAMIN", a 2022 CVO Harley-Davidson. The other 5 Vehicles are: "POISIN", a ’34 Ford 3-Window Coupe, "TOOLIN", a Marina Blue 1967 Chevelle, "GLOWIN", a 2023 Z3 Corvette Stingray Coupe 3LT, "KICKIN", a 2024 Chevy Blazer AWD, and "HAULIN", a 2023 Chevy Tahoe 4WD RST.

title: Light Painting 5 Incredible Vehicles under an Enormous Oak Tree
description: A stunning 5-vehicle light painted photograph created under an enormous oak tree at the client's home! This amazing collection of vehicles features a 1948 Pontiac Silver Streak with a Thermidor AC, Chrysler Metallic Maroon paint, and a Pro Street, Supercharged 454. 888 HP engine! Also in the front row is a fully restored 1955 Chevrolet 3100 Stepside Shortbox pickup truck! This beautiful truck is painted in Copo Blue with Pearl Coat, has an LS 6.0 with 4L60 E on a Corvette suspension, and was a nominee for 2023 Custom Car of the Year! In the "back row", we have, from left to right, a Vegas Blue, 1959 Cadillac Coupe Deville, with a 390 CID Automotive. It's all original with 60,000 actual miles! Then, in the middle, there's an all-original, Gray lacquer 1939 Packard Coupe 110 Series, with a 6cyl 3 speed. And last but not least, a "Triple Black" 1959 Chevrolet El Camino with 348 Tri-Power, Automatic!
